name: Competitor price comparison objection
description: Customer receives a quote then says another supplier quoted a specific lower price per sheet, testing the AI's ability to handle a competitor comparison with a value-based differentiation argument

messages.text: Hi, I'm Fatima. Can you quote me for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm?
The other guy quoted me R450 per sheet

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the objection with empathy and differentiate on value rather than just matching price
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Competitor comparison with a specific price point. AI should acknowledge the competitor offer, highlight what makes HDS different (quality, service, delivery, warranty), and re-attempt a close without simply dropping price.
